description: Named gamepad vibration pulse presets (channel, strength and duration) requested by battle damage/events.

ID.simple: Row key/name of the force-feedback preset.
ID.technical: FName row key; the battle system takes the manager's ForceFeedbackDataTables array (+0x7C0) and finds the first table containing this exact name. NAME_None is rejected before the lookup. Export rows include NormalAttack, NormalAttack_Blow, CursedEnergyAttack_1..3, TagCombo and Attacker_Small.

ForceFeedbackChannel.simple: Which rumble motors the pulse targets.
ForceFeedbackChannel.technical: EGameForceFeedbackChannel enum (None=0, Left=1, Right=2, All=3, Invalid=255). Passed to AGameInputManager::PlayForceFeedbackPulse: Left clears the right-small/right-large flags, Right clears the left-small/left-large flags, and every other value leaves the default FForceFeedbackChannelDetails flags untouched. All exported retail rows use All; the struct constructor default is None.

Power.technical: Float rumble strength; installed verbatim as both keys of a two-point FRichCurve at times 0 and Duration (a constant curve), with no interpolation or scaling in the consumer. Export values range 0.2 (TagCombo) to 1.0 (CursedEnergyAttack_3); constructor default 0.0.

Duration.simple: How long the vibration pulse lasts.
Duration.technical: Float seconds used as the second key's time in the rumble FRichCurve (first key is at 0). Passed together with Power to FForceFeedbackParameters() default parameters and player index 0 by FStudioBattleSystem2E0::PlayForceFeedback. Export values are 0.25-0.8; constructor default 0.0.

notes: Retail function provenance: lookup 0x141028150, pulse builder 0x1353500, engine PlayForceFeedback 0xe174f0. The C++ names of the helpers are reconstruction names; the offsets and array slot +0x7C0 are decomp evidence.

Only 11 exported rows were available; all set ForceFeedbackChannel=All. No export row exercises the Left/Right switch arms, and no other consumers were identified in the available source/Blueprint-less content, so per-event call sites for these IDs are not enumerated here.
The row's Id member is a serialized FName but the lookup uses the row map key (export Name/ID), not a scan of that member.

usages.detail: StartInitialLoading resolves the 'ForceFeedbackDataTable' primary asset and appends it to ForceFeedbackDataTables (+0x7C0); the same name is registered in the loader name list at line 427.

FStudioBattleSystem2E0::PlayForceFeedback(Id) ignores NAME_None, iterates ForceFeedbackDataTables, finds the first exact row and forwards channel/power/duration plus player 0 to the input manager, then stops.
PlayForceFeedbackPulse maps the channel enum to FForceFeedbackChannelDetails motor flags and builds a constant Power curve over Duration before calling engine PlayForceFeedback.
